title: Midjourney's Advertising Strategy: The Brand That Never Markets, Marketing
summary: Midjourney ads: 88 Meta ads to the gallery with no tracking, prices only in search text ads, and help-center pages turned into search ads.
body_markdown:
Midjourney is the company that famously never markets. No sales team, no launch campaigns, a Discord server and word of mouth. Ramp's October 2026 AI category data has it as the most-purchased Image and Video AI vendor, bought by 41% of the buyers in the category.


It also runs paid ads. 172 on Google, with 344 headline and description variations, and 88 live on Meta as of 13 October 2026. Quietly. Not one of the 199 image and video variations on Google mentions a price, a plan, a feature or a competitor.


The ad is the product's own gallery. 43 Google variations send the click to midjourney.com/explore?tab=top: the feed of what other people made.


## Midjourney ads: key findings


- **74** of 88 live Meta ads launched on one day, **2 October 2026** . All **88** link to the logged-out gallery, midjourney.com/explore
- **0** tracking parameters on any Meta ad. No UTM, no ref, no campaign name
- **0** of 88 Meta ads say "AI". **78** say "imagine" or "imagination"
- **0** of 199 Google image and video variations mention a price. Every price on the account is in a text ad
- **11** search variations are help-center page titles, including "Turning Off Automatic Renewals". The fingerprint of dynamic search ads
- The "Free Trials" ad says there's no free trial, then points to the **niji·journey** phone app
- **12** Google ads are written natively in Japanese, Korean, Spanish and Portuguese
- Image and video ads run in **192** regions. The US is one market among them
- **41%** of Image and Video AI buyers on Ramp buy Midjourney, the category's #1


## How Midjourney's funnel is wired


Two funnels, and intent picks which one you fall into. Pictures go to the gallery with no price and no tag. Words go to the homepage, where every price on the account lives. Some of those words aren't even written by Midjourney.


### The Meta launch was one day and one URL


74 of the 88 live Meta ads started on 2 October 2026. Since then new ones arrive one or two a day.


All 88 link to the same place: midjourney.com/explore, the logged-out community feed. No UTM. No ref. No campaign name. Every one runs on all five Meta surfaces, WhatsApp and Audience Network included.


What the ads carry Midjourney on Meta


Destination midjourney.com/explore, 88 of 88


Tracking parameters 0


Placements Facebook, Instagram, Threads, WhatsApp, Audience Network on all 88


Launch day 2 October 2026 for 74 of 88


Ads that say "AI" 0


Ads that say "imagine" or "imagination" 78


That's a broad, placement-agnostic buy, measured at the site level rather than ad by ad. The gallery is the landing page. The "sign in to create" wall on top of it is the conversion step.


### Intent decides the funnel, not the audience


Ad type Where it goes Price in the ad


Meta, all formats The gallery Never


Google image and video, 199 variations The gallery or the homepage 0 of 199


Google text, 108 ads The homepage "From $10 / month" in 5 variations, plans in 7, "Worth Every Dollar", "The AI Artists Pay For"


A picture is shown to people who never asked. A price is shown only to people who typed a question. Same company, two funnels, split by whether the viewer was looking.


### Google writes some of Midjourney's search ads from its help center


11 text variations carry headlines that are help-center page titles, word for word:


- "Turning Off Automatic Renewals"
- "Discord Nitro Subscription - Midjourney"
- "Free Trials - Midjourney"
- "Comparing Midjourney Plans"
- "Prompt Basics - Midjourney"
- "Version 8.2"


Nobody writes a search ad called "Turning Off Automatic Renewals". That's the fingerprint of dynamic search ads: Google crawls the site and builds the headline from whichever page matches the query.


Two consequences. Midjourney pays for clicks from people searching how to cancel. And the "Free Trials" ad tells the searcher there's no free trial, then points them to the niji·journey phone app, the one free door left.


### Search is cut by job and language. Display is cut by nothing


The text ads read like keyword-themed ad groups, one headline per job:


Headline Who it's for


Architectural Visuals - AI for Design Teams Architects and studios


Fantasy Character Creator Tabletop and game players


Create Illustrations With AI Illustrators


Create Photorealistic Images Photographers and marketers


Midjourney Editor - Describe the Change You Want Anyone editing an existing image


12 ads are written natively in Japanese, Korean, Spanish and Portuguese. "数秒で4枚生成", four images in seconds. "4 imágenes por indicación". Not translations of the English, but their own lines.


The image and video ads do the opposite. One mood, everywhere: they run across 192 regions, and the US is just one market among them, with 83 placements against Spain's 93 and France's 92.


## Google: the gallery is the landing page


### Where the clicks go


Destination Variations


midjourney.com (homepage, any spelling) 161


midjourney.com/explore?tab=top 43


/create, /start, /for-creatives, docs 6


Destination not shown 134


43 is a floor, because 134 variations show no destination at all. Of the 210 that do, 20% go to the gallery.


It is a strange landing page. A feed of other people's images, ranked by the community, no signup form above the fold. Midjourney does not explain the product. It shows what the product made and lets a stranger scroll.


Every one of those 43 variations is video or image. Not one text ad points there. Text ads, the ones people type searches into, go to the homepage.


A Google display ad first shown 27 September 2026. Headline, one line, an Open button. 13 October 2026.


### Headlines that sell a feeling


Headline Variations


Bring Your Ideas to Life 20


Your Imagination, Unlocked 11


A Vehicle for Imagination 8


Explore Your Imagination 8


Immersive creations await 7


Across the 199 image and video variations: no price, no plan, no feature name, no version number, no comparison. "A Vehicle for Imagination" is the whole pitch.


The description under it is just as soft. "Transform your imagination into stunning visuals. Explore limitless creative possibilities" runs in 40 variations. "Create visual masterpieces with Midjourney, an engine for your exploration" in 12.


### The exception: search text


The text ads are different, and I should say so. 145 of the 344 variations are text, and a few of them do talk money. 5 mention plans "from $10 / month". 8 mention plans. Two read "Free Trials". "Comparing Midjourney Plans" shows up three times.


So the rule is not "never mention price". The rule is: price lives where someone typed a question. Where nobody asked, the ad is a picture and a mood.


### When it started


First shown Ads


Before 2026 19


January to May 2026 10


August 2026 17


September 2026 60


October 2026 1


The earliest dated ad is 28 August 2024. For a year the account was a trickle: 19 dated ads before 2026. Then August and September 2026 account for 77 of the 107 dated ads. 128 of the 172 have shown in the last week.


Quiet is not the same as small.


## Meta: one line, 88 times


A Midjourney static ad with the headline "Create at the speed of your imagination". 13 October 2026.


88 live Meta ads: 40 carousels, 34 videos and 14 statics. Every one goes to midjourney.com/explore.


Headline Ads


Create at the speed of your imagination 54


Explore What's Possible 8


Edit at the Speed of Your Imagination 8


Your Imagination, Unlocked 8


Keep the Car. Change the World Around It. 8


Introducing Midjourney Video, Bring Your Ideas to Life 1 each


74 of the 88 launched on 2 October 2026. One launch day, most of the set at once. The rest followed one or two a day.


The sharper difference is one word. None of the 88 says "AI". 41% of 263 ads from rival image and video AI tools do. Midjourney says "imagine" or "imagination" in 78 of its 88. The rivals say it in 3 of 263.


It is the same line as Google, "imagination" again, with one change. Meta is where the product gets named: Video, and the Editor. "Edit at the Speed of Your Imagination" and "Keep the Car. Change the World Around It." carry the editing feature, 16 of the 88. Even there the headline is a sentence, not a spec.


A Midjourney editor ad. The prompt is the only text. 13 October 2026.


## What actually makes this work


The product is the creative. The community gallery is a feed of ads Midjourney never had to make, from people who made them for free. Sending paid clicks there turns users' work into the landing page.


Then the copy gets out of the way. One feeling, 79 times. No price on the display side, no feature race, no rival named. A reader who already has a picture in their head does not need a comparison table.


That only works for a brand with a product that looks like this. Most can't. But the pattern travels: put the best output of the product where the click lands, and keep the headline to a sentence.
